spans.s:
n. (-तं)
1 Striking, wounding, killing.
2 A bruise, a blow.
3 An arrow.
4 Product (of a sum in multiplication.)
E.
हन to kill, घञ् affix, and the radical letters changed respectively to घ and त.

m. (-कः)
A murderer, a maimer, &c.
E.
हन as above, with ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-नः)
A murderer, a killer.
n. (-नं)
1 Killing, slaughter.
2

Immolating victims.
E.
हन to kill, युन् affix, and घात substituted for the radical.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Striking, hurting, killing.
E.
हन to kill, causal form, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be killed, what may be or ought to be killed, &c.
E.
हन to kill, तव्य affix, and घा substituted.

n. (-नं)
1 A slaughter house.
2 A place of execution.
E.
घात, and स्थान place.

m. (-तिः)
1 Catching or killing birds, fowling.
2 Killing in general.
3 Striking.
E.
हन to kill or hurt, affix इञ्, and the radical changed: see घात.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Murderous, felonious, who or what strikes or kills.
E.
हन to kill, णिनि aff.

m. (-क्षी)
A hawk or falcon.
E.
घाति fowling, and पक्षिन् a bird.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Mischievous, hurtful.
2 Cruel, savage, violent, ferocious.
E.
हन to kill, changed to घत, and उकञ् aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Proper or fit to be killed.
E.
हन, and ण्यत् aff.
